result.title: Secure Formal Raising: Protecting the Development of AI through Executable Properties
result.summary: Model raising revisits Turing's developmental view of machine intelligence. Formal Raising (FR) has recently been proposed to complement this view with explicit behavioral properties. This paper extends that proposal to the security of the raising environment. Secure Formal Raising (SFR) models policy integrity, authorization, and confidential data flow using four-valued evidence that preserves unknown and inconsistent assessments. We prove six security invariants and show that they force admission to accept only confirmed evidence. A plain-C reference implementation satisfies the invariants in a bounded exhaustive exploration, which also exposes a confused-deputy gap for tool calls that a provenance requirement closes.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 Secure Formal Raising，用保留「未知/不一致」的四值证据刻画 raising 环境中的策略完整性、授权与机密数据流，并证明六条安全不变量、给出 C 参考实现。
AI.relevance_reason: 论述对象是 AI 开发环境的安全准入与工具调用溯源，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选与停止决策；四值证据仅服务于访问控制判定，与 LVR 的相关性过于间接，缺少可核查的具体借鉴线索。
